title: Offset blocks
headline:
Choose your first
AI project.
description: The same offset blue composition, with consistent curved joins and a very fine texture confined to the lit block.
changes: Added fine grain inside the lit cyan block.
Kept the blue field, lime inset, and headline crisp.
patternRule: Build the offset fragments from generous circular joins, using a 128-pixel large radius and smaller related radii. Preserve the quiet field and asymmetric crop.
gradientRule: The blue background remains flat. Directional cyan light and low-opacity fine grain belong only to one filled block; the front face uses a tonal-blue transition.

title: Cutout join
headline:
Connect your
company’s knowledge.
description: The same blue cutout and forest field, with a broad light transition replacing the visible diagonal stripe.
changes: Removed the hard diagonal highlight layer.
Spread the light smoothly across the blue cutout.
Preserved the open forest field and lime headline.
patternRule: Use one oversized asymmetric cutout with a broad step and a generous notch. Let the negative space carry the headline and retain the original crop.
gradientRule: A broad horizontal blue-to-cyan transition stays inside the left cutout. The forest field remains completely flat; no grain or corner glow.
